messages.content: The Requirement Extractor is designed to interpret and process multiple user queries in a single input, especially in the context of inventory management and product information.
My package has arrived, I ordered size UK 34 but why is it different from the size 34 pants I bought from here before? There's a difference of ±5cm, so the new one doesn't fit me.

function.name: check_order_status
function.description: Check the status of a customer's order using their order ID. Returns the current state of the order, estimated delivery date, and any associated tracking information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer's order.

include_tracking.description: Flag to indicate whether to include tracking information in the response.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to verify ownership of the order. If not provided, ownership verification is skipped.

date_format.description: The desired format for the date returned. The default format is 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

order_status.description: Current status of the order. If not provided, the default status is 'processing'.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery date of the order, in the format of 'MM/DD/YYYY'. If not provided, the default is null, representing that the estimated date is not yet available.

tracking_info.description: Tracking information including courier and tracking number if available. If not provided, the default is null, indicating that tracking information is not yet available.

message.content:
I’m really sorry you’re having trouble fitting your new pair! Size discrepancies can happen even when the same “UK 34” label appears on two items—different brands (and sometimes even different styles within the same brand) use slightly varied measurements. Here’s what you can do: | Step | What to Do | Why It Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Verify the measurement** | Use a tape measure to confirm the waist circumference (in cm). Compare this to the original pair’s measurement. | Confirms how big the discrepancy actually is. | | **2️⃣ Check our size chart** | Look at the official size‑by‑size table on our website (usually under *Help → Sizes*). Make sure both pairs were meant to match the same style category (e.g., slim vs. regular cut). | Some cuts run smaller/larger than others. | | **3️⃣ Contact Customer Support** | Send us a quick note via chat/phone/email with:
• Order #
• Your name & address
• Photo of the tag + photo showing the actual waist measurement
• Desired resolution (exchange, refund, store credit) | Gives us all details to act quickly. | | **4️⃣ Return / Exchange Process** | Once approved, we’ll ship you a prepaid return label. You can either send back the item for a full refund or request a replacement in a better-fitting size. | Keeps things hassle‑free for you. | If you’d prefer to try another size first, let us know which size you think would work best based on the measured waist. We’ll see if we still have stock and arrange an expedited shipment. --- ### Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Can sizes differ between colors/styles?** | Yes – some fabrics stretch more or less, and certain cuts (slim, relaxed, tapered) will feel tighter/further apart. | | **Do you offer free exchanges?** | Absolutely. All exchanges come with a prepaid shipping label. | | **What if the new pair doesn’t fit after exchanging?** | Let us know right away—we’ll keep working until you get something that fits perfectly. | Feel free to reply directly to this email or hop onto live chat. We want you to love your purchase, so we’ll sort this out together! Best regards, [Your Name] Customer Care Team ---
